thread.title: New Vera Rubin Observatory discovers 2,000 unknown asteroids within 10 hours
thread.title_full: New Vera Rubin Observatory discovers 2,000 unknown asteroids within 10 hours

author: FOX10Phoenix
title: New Vera Rubin Observatory discovers 2,000 unknown asteroids within 10 hours
text:
The Vera C. Rubin Observatory team just revealed the first images taken by the observatory.
While about 20,000 previously unknown asteroids are discovered every year by telescopes around the world and spacecraft in orbit, the first images by the new Vera C. Rubin Observatory revealed 2,000 undiscovered asteroids taken during about 10 hours of scanning the night sky. There are dozens of telescopes on Earth and satellites in the sky searching for new objects that might pose a threat to our planet. The National Science Foundation-Department of Energy's Vera C.
These new asteroids, including seven near-Earth asteroids, pose no danger to our planet. According to the NSF, Rubin will discover millions of new asteroids within the first two years of observations.Find more updates on this story at FOXWeather.com.
